description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and addition of a ground floor side window to the house with associated internal works, expansion of the existing front garden with replacement front boundary treatments and re-provision of a single front car parking space.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (4D-239  E 00 (Rev A); 4D-239  E 01; 4D-239  E 02; 4D-239  E 03; 4D-239  E 04; 4D-239  E 05; 4D-239  E 06; 4D-239  E 07; 4D-239  E 08; 4D-239  P 01 (Rev A); 4D-239  P 01A (Rev A); 4D-239 P 02 (Rev A); 4D-239  P 03 (Rev A); 4D-239  P 04 (Rev A); 4D-239  P 05 (Rev A); 4D-239  P 06 (Rev A); 4D-239  P 07 (Rev A); 4D-239  P 08 (Rev A)  Received:  13 February 2023) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - Prior to completion of development, the existing side vehicular access to the existing front garage shall be removed to facilitate the expansion of the house's front garden with replacement boundary treatments as hereby approved.  
No replacement front or side vehicular access to the existing garage from the private highway The Marais shall be established without the approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The replacement front boundary treatments adjoining the private highway The Marais and smaller front car parking space shall permanently not exceed a height of two metres.
